# QR decoder

`jsQR.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of [cozmo/jsQR](https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR), version **1.4.0**.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js

SHA-256: `bc40c8a15196236b2314db0856f72ca0b49980cd5413b8c852a7349f5fee0859`.

Licensed under Apache-2.0; the upstream license is included in `jsQR.LICENSE`.
Served locally and loaded only when a QR image is selected or a camera needs the software decoder.
